datasets.name: Capitals
datasets.sql:
SELECT ID,  hdate, total, trid
  FROM dm_capitalization
  where ID# = :ContractID

datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select cust.name,
       cont.amount,
       cont.currency,
       cstate.facticaldebt,
       cstate.facticalinterestdebt,
      (select ostat from tenostat where acc_id=acc.clientaccid) ostat
from dm_contracts cont,
     customers cust,
     dm_contract_accounts acc,
     dm_history_currstate cstate
where
    cont.id = :ContractID and
    cust.id = cont.customerID and
    acc.id# = :ContractID and
    cstate.id# = :ContractID

datasets.name: CustAcc
datasets.sql:
select clientaccid 
       ,dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount(ContractAccID) as ContractAccNo
       ,dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount(InterestAccID) as InterestAccNo
       ,dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount(ClientAccID)   as ClientAccNo
from dm_contract_accounts
where id# = :Contractid
